articles.headline: Kyndryl says 98% of organizations delayed modernization and suffered negative business impacts
articles.summary: Kyndryl’s new global report says modernization is now a business-orchestration problem, not just an IT project. For companies, the takeaway is that delaying platform upgrades can directly hurt operations, resilience, and competitiveness, especially when legacy systems have to coexist with AI and modern infrastructure.

articles.headline: FTC opens industry-wide probe into Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI labs over rogue AI agents
articles.summary: A US regulator has opened an industry-wide investigation into potential consumer harms from AI agents, signaling faster compliance pressure for vendors and buyers alike. Businesses deploying agentic AI should expect stronger scrutiny of security controls, testing, liability, and governance requirements.

articles.headline: Micron reports record DRAM and data center revenue amid tight supply
articles.summary: Micron’s latest quarterly figures show DRAM revenue up sharply and data center revenue at a record level, highlighting strong AI infrastructure demand and constrained memory supply. That matters for businesses because memory scarcity can keep hardware costs elevated and shape procurement timelines for servers and cloud-backed AI workloads.
